text:
sasha: quick heads-up 11 I merged a tiny copy pass in PR #4301 but noticed two problems reported by support: broken links in the pricing tiers section and outdated metering header examples. can someone triage before we promote the docs to staging?
maya: share the exact links please?
sasha: main one is /pricing#tiers-overview which 404s now after the panel rename. also /docs/metering/headers.md has examples using Authorization: Bearer <KEY> instead of x-api-key and the SDK snippets still call generateText().
jonathan: thanks. we changed the dashboard ID names last sprint (metering -> consumption) which explains the 404s. we should add redirects and update the anchor names.
liam: prefer adding a redirects.yml entry for old anchors -> new anchors so external links keep working. also add a small test that the redirect exists.
emily: support asked for a worked example for burst credits calculations 11 customers get confused about how bursts map to tokens. suggest adding a compact example: "If a customer has a 50k token/day allowance and a burst window of 1k tokens/min, a 2x burst over 10 minutes consumes 20k burst credits" (or similar formula).
sasha: will draft a tiny worked example and include a short formula and a minimal Python helper function to compute estimated burst consumption.
maya: also backport to docs-1.2 branch. some enterprise customers are still on that doc version.
sasha: noted, will open a backport PR after main merge.
docs-bot: PR #4309 opened by sasha 023 "docs: pricing redirects + metering header SDK snippet updates". Reviewers requested: @jonathan, @emily. CI: running.
jonathan: tiny SDK nit: use client.generate({ model: 'rwd/light-2', input: '...' }) and show headers explicitly as { headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.RW_KEY } } in both python and ts. avoid generateText/generate_text legacy names.
sasha: ok updating. drafting snippets now. current draft python snippet: ```python
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('RW_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='rwd/light-2', input='hello', headers={'x-api-key': os.environ['RW_KEY']})
print(resp.output)
```
TS snippet: ```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd/light-2', input: 'hello' }, { headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.RW_KEY } })
console.log(resp.output)
```
liam: good. also add a short migration note in /docs/migration/api-headers.md explaining the header change and why (security / uniformity).
emily: for the burst worked example, keep it compact and easy to scan. include a one-line formula and a numeric example. maybe also a small table but keep Slack thread short, we can add the table in the doc PR.
sasha: will add checklist in PR description: 1) update pricing anchors and add redirects.yml entry, 2) replace dashboard names in the text, 3) update metering header docs and add py/ts snippets with x-api-key, 4) add burst credits worked example + formula, 5) add migration note and changelog entry, 6) backport to 1.2.
maya: perfect. ping when CI passes and I'll QA staging. :thumbsup:
jonathan: will review the snippet changes this afternoon. thanks for handling this, sasha.
sasha: aiming to wrap & merge today, will post status here.
